content:
Hello! I'm happy to announce that I've mostly (it still needs a lot of cleaning up and more documentation) finished my project of formalizing the Bourgain randomness extractor, and it can be found at https://command-master.github.io/lean-bourgain/ .

A few results I've proved for it which might be of independent interest:

  • A version of Szemeredi-Trotter in prime fields (Theorem 6.2 in J. Bourgain, N. Katz and T. Tao, A sum-product estimate in finite fields, and applications)
  • The generalized XOR lemma (Lemma 4.1 in A. Rao, An Exposition of Bourgain’s 2-Source Extractor)
  • Some definitions and theorems about probability distributions on Fintypes.
  • Every source is a convex combination of flat sources.
  • Some simple results in additive combinatorics.
  • Definitions and a few theorems about lines and projective transformations.
